notes.title: New demo, new levels + more about the zombies
notes.content:
To celebrate our participation in the [i]Zombies vs Vampires Fest[/i] (26 May - 2 Jun, 2025), we're sharing a [b]new demo and a full news about the zombies[/b] in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/f2058749040e4c8c92ecf3245d1fc54a558703be.png[/img]
[h2][u]The demo[/u][/h2]
After a few private playtests, we're now ready to publicly share our latest game version! 

In this demo, you'll be able to play the new character: [b]Amber[/b]!

A demo run should last around 45 minutes. We won't say more so you can fully discover this new level by yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/4f4abf2bc41703b98d10d324e2df780cb39eba0b.gif[/img]

[h3]Share your feedback![/h3]
We're always very excited to hear what you think of the game every time we share a new demo.
Fill out the feedback form to help us: [url=https://forms.gle/hrvodCY5ypXn4qMu6]Demo Feedback Form[/url]


[h2][u]More about the zombies[/u][/h2]
As we're part of the Steam event [b]Zombies and Vampires Festival[/b], we wanted to share more about the zombies in Vultures! Let's dive into it!

[h3]What are the zombie games/movies/books that inspired you for yours?[/h3]
We're big fans of zombie media, and the original Resident Evil trilogy on PlayStation (1996–1999) was a huge starting point for us. Army of the Dead (2021) inspired the idea of a mission deep into a ruined city—core to Vultures’ gameplay. We also pulled from Romero’s Land of the Dead (2005) for its dystopian city vibe, and Planet Terror (2007) for its militarized zombies. Those references helped shape the tone and action of our world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/81311df90fe78bda4202b8500838231ea779e42f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Will each level have its own zombies?[/h3]
Each level introduces new enemies—some of them are zombies with unique appearances, but not all of them. Vultures also features mutants, which are more dangerous and behave very differently. We’ve planned three major areas where new zombie types will appear, each more deadly than the last.

[h3]What is the process behind creating a new zombie?[/h3]
It usually starts with a gameplay idea—some new mechanic or behavior we want to explore. Once we have that, we design the look to visually communicate the threat to the player. We want you to feel how it plays just by looking at it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/643924903fa632a0d8d1228a27b41f1fd7c85567.png[/img]

[h3]Are some zombies more resistant to certain weapons/attacks?[/h3]
Definitely. Vultures includes a variety of weapons, each with different effects. Some enemies are weak to specific types. For example, the SWAT zombie is heavily armored and resistant to melee attacks—but fire? That’ll bring him down fast.

[h3]What are the inspirations behind the explosive zombie?[/h3]
This one started as two separate ideas: one was a zombie that spat acid like Mortal Kombat’s Reptile, the other was a fast runner that exploded on contact. We decided to merge them into a single enemy, and its final design took some visual cues from the Lying Figures in Silent Hill 2. It first appears in the military’ base, so we designed it to feel like it belonged there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/bb680931f49cfa1b555f577e78fa75f45dac0a62.gif[/img]

[h3]What are the inspirations behind the Scorpio zombie?[/h3]
Technically, it’s a mutant we call Offspring. It has a crustacean-like body and a tail it uses to strike. Visually, we were inspired by the cursed crew from Pirates of the Caribbean (The Flying Dutchman), and conceptually, it evolved over multiple iterations. These Offspring are children of a major boss, which adds to their lore and threat level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/d681cf3112e0e017ae9187761e1d5ae915974034.gif[/img]

We have many more zombies we can't wait to share with you. Let us know which zombie you'd like to see in the game!

Join us on Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/vsxD6n8P8J][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/b179de58911c3ae80270f461b7fb392936338a70.png[/img][/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Firesquid][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/f5587fa419d5105228d86f0544713ccd52f041fe.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: What are the threats and enemies in Vultures?
notes.content:
Vultures - Scavengers of Death is a zombie horror game, so there are a ton of enemies and threats to make the game a chilling experience. Let's dive into it!

[h3]What are the different threats in the game?[/h3]
[b]Zombies[/b]
The zombies are the direct enemies, they won't give you any rest. They will hunt you and destroy every part of your being. You will want to either deal with them quickly or sneak your way out of theirs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/54bb40ba942cd66c63cdeb3ad26c7582fb01a5d7.png[/img][i]In-engine laid down assets of the zombie policeman[/i]

[b]Storage & bullets Management[/b]
There are different threats that enhance the chilling and scary feeling of the game, and they are not all coming from zombies! Storage and bullet management, for example, is a classic component of the survival horror genre. We wanted to bring this mechanic into turn-based combat to add an extra layer of strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/2792d8425011d6d5111fa49d94eb30a9d2229817.png[/img][i]Screenshot of pistol ammunition collected in inventory[/i]

[b]Environments[/b]
The environments themselves are designed to be labyrinths and difficult to explore, featuring different threats and hazardous areas, such as trap-filled rooms. The map will be your best ally, only if you find it..!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/69c86595ee97372aeb2b7b9b846ebb2476fd0557.png[/img][i]Screenshot of the map[/i]

[h3]What are the enemies of the first level?[/h3]
In the game, there are different types of enemies, the "normal" ones, and bosses. For the first level happening in the Police station, we decided to go for three main enemies:
[list]
[*] [b]Conventional Zombies[/b]: These include members of the police force and civilians. Their inspiration comes from the Resident Evil games and several zombie movies. In the final version of the game, there will also be a female variation of these zombies.
[*] [b]Arvid (known as Shadow)[/b]: These enemies exist only in the protagonists' minds. Their appearance and combat style are inspired by the guilt the characters carry from their past. Silent Hill heavily influenced the design and concept of these enemies.
[*] [b]Commander Riggs[/b]: Unlike conventional zombies, this zombie can command others, giving them orders to attack in specific ways or defend him.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/aa9f76b8084235f8fdc9c97dad3557330e96d0a6.png[/img][i]Concept arts of the first level's zombies[/i]

[h3]Why is there stealth in the game?[/h3]
Stealth serves as an alternative to avoid combat and optimize resource usage. The tension generated by avoiding enemy detection contributes to the sense of fear we want the game to evoke.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/aa91951893d9a005b201c52996c3ae929d893f31.gif[/img][i]Leopoldo sneak walking towards a zombie[/i]

[h3]Does choosing Amber or Leopoldo impact the game experience?[/h3]
Yes, each character offers a distinct gameplay style. Leopoldo is more resilient and focuses on firearm combat, while Amber excels at fast and stealthy movement. But more on them in a few weeks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/61c55cff022e21140a438082d6e835344d317910.jpg[/img][i]Key art with Leopoldo and Amber[/i]

We are soon coming back with [b]a new demo[/b], so stay tuned on Steam and our social media!

notes.title: Why did we choose turn based for our horror game?
notes.content:
Hey zombie killers,
A question that often comes back is "[i]Why did you choose to have a turn-based combat in your horror game? That's unusual![/i]" Well, we're here to answer you!

First, don't forget to try our last demo, currently available for the Turn-based Carnival! It will give you a good sense of what we're trying to achieve with these turn-based mechanics.
Share your feedback with us: https://forms.gle/jnWMY4aCL277mB6H8


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/3c32b9035dccec7f16beedb1060edc7931f973c7.png[/img]

[h2]Why Turn-based?[/h2]

[u][h3]Horror games are often RTS to play on suspense, jumpscares, etc. Why did you choose to go turn-based?[/h3][/u]
We liked the idea of giving players time to think through each situation. In most RTS games, players only react to situations without the chance to pause and evaluate if there’s a better strategy.
We were also drawn to offering something unconventional regarding combat within the horror genre.

[u][h3]What are the turn-based games that inspired you for Vultures' combat?[/h3][/u]
The main inspîrations are Into the Breach, Colony Ship, Xcom, and the obvious Dungeon and Dragons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/2ee57dcc5b2167744023dc15e6bc926d9e1b5e20.png[/img]

[u][h3]How do you lean into the horror genre with the turn-based mechanics?[/h3][/u]
It all started with the idea of making a Resident Evil roguelike set on a retro 80s terminal, using text commands. We tried to distill key survival horror mechanics and translate them into a different context, like a board game.
We love retro aesthetics, so when transitioning to a 3D video game, we aimed to pay homage to classic Resident Evil games from the PS1 era.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/a63b10a0998bb36bcdf510b357f34d88e1816867.png[/img]

[u][h3]Do other mechanics in the game (like the objects collected, resource management, story evolution, etc.) play a part in turn-based combat?[/h3][/u]
Resource management is fundamental in both genres—turn-based combat and survival horror. We kept this in mind when designing weapons and equipment that would give players more strategic options.
Spatial control is also key: the player controls a single character with high damage and movement capabilities, but in tight spaces where enemies become deadly obstacles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/9c0e3713f48aacfb1a59f5a2586fff3815762696.png[/img]

[h2]Important note[/h2]
We were considering having [b]procedurally generated levels[/b] in the game but concluded that it wouldn't be the right choice for many reasons. Here is an explanation of why.

We made some prototypes and experiments using an early tool for level design. While creating the structure of a level was okay (generating a level with viable navigation, entry & exit points, and some solvable puzzles such as locked doors and keys to find around) it was a brand new challenge when it came to "populate" rooms with a realistic arrangement and good horror vibe. Managing to generate an infinite amount of coherent rooms with furniture arrangement and realistic space uses was a struggle at this stage where the environment was barely limited to the precinct area that we already had in the demo, so let's imagine multiplying the environment with a lot of various locations such as hospital, mall, underground parking, ravaged streets, offices, etc... Struggling already on the very first steps was making the full plan a too-heavy milestone to fulfill so we had to decide to cut it now since we still have time to switch plan and go for handcrafted levels before it's too late in the production.

We hope you understand our decision and that you'll give us feedback on the current demo! Don't hesitate to spam the Steam discussions!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/79136df4f99274d0d2fff6106e342e189b61a7fe.gif[/img]

notes.title: Our new demo!
notes.content:
Hello Zombie Crusher,

We are at the Inde Horror Showcase and our [b]new trailer is here[/b]!

[list]

[*] Preview objects can be rotated with the Middle Mouse Button, and the panel can be closed with the Right Mouse Button

notes.title: Indie Horror Showcase and Silent Hill 2 inspo!
notes.content:
Hello zombie hunters,
We're participating in the Indie Horror Showcase 2024! We’re thrilled to be part of this event that celebrates the spookiest games from the indie horror community. Discover our [b]brand new trailer[/b].



For the event, we're also pushing a new demo on Steam! This demo will have a few additions and changes from the previous one, with new visuals and even a new enemy! Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/13fe1cdb3cdbce7d36c458f3484479506c270863.png[/img]
Even if Halloween has not started yet, it already smells like zombies and blood in the air. 

[h3]Silent Hill 2[/h3]
In my restless dreams, I see that town... Salento Valley
Silent Hill 2 revived horror - Vultures will make it tactical.

For Vultures Scavengers of Death, we were inspired by Silent Hill 2. What better than the recent remake release to talk a bit about these inspirations?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/b6aef0f6fb424b80271fea4592a401087eb7af8a.png[/img]

[b]What inspired us in Silent Hill?[/b]
[list]
[*] Aesthetic of retro horror games from the PlayStation 1 era
[*] The element of fog and the fear of not knowing what lies beyond
[*] Nightmarish enemies, some of which are manifestations of their own fears and guilt
[*] The main characters have traumas and guilt that they will confront during their campaign to save Salento
[*] Elements that may seem paranormal and cult-like
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/1bc1199a02bf3208298c6f04854ca221da9f031d.png[/img]

[b]Why do we choose to keep this retro aesthetic?[/b]
[list]
[*] Nostalgy
[*] A love letter to the original survival horror games from the PSx era
[*] The 'less details' encourages players’ imagination
[*] It gives more freedom in terms of the aesthetic approach
[*] Simplify the production of 3D assets
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/79136df4f99274d0d2fff6106e342e189b61a7fe.gif[/img]

Did you play the recent Silent Hill 2? Because we LOVED it!

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/vsxD6n8P8J]Discord[/url] to chat about it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/6899b0a9690bf8839003186e970fcff41b0f2482.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Retro inspirations + updated demo!
notes.content:
Hello zombie hunters,

We're participating in Boomstock 2024 with an [b]updated demo[/b]! Boomstock is a celebration of all Boomer Shooters and kick-ass action games in general, all connected by their love for the good old days of gaming, shining through in the games’ artstyle, gameplay, or both.

What new can you find in this demo?
[list]
[*] New animations for the player character;
[*] New skins for the zombies;
[*] UI iteration (like energy booster is usable now);
[*] Characters' names updated;
[*] Boss encountered revisited to be more interesting and challenging;
[*] Add a new particle effect to the Spit attack of Irons, the Chief of Police;
[*] Replaced all the references to Irons by Rigss (our new Police Chief);
[*] Fixed the message shown in certain cases when pushing enemies wasn't possible;
[*] Fixed a bug that was showing a dialog between Leopoldo and the Radio while the briefcase was being shown.
[/list]
[h3]Play the updated demo now![/h3]


[h2]Our inspirations for Vultures' retro vibe[/h2]
We were very inspired by the older [b]Resident Evil games on PlayStation 1[/b] for the creepy and gloomy ambiance. The same goes for the zombie looks, their 3D models' texturing. And it was the same for the story. In Vultures, you have to manage your inventory, look for clues and a cure, or at least try to understand what happens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/a79a91ef3dd57781507785454b39092da378348a.jpg[/img]
[i]The Resident Evil 1, 2 and 3 Playstation 1 game covers[/i]

Another great reference and game we loved to play was [b]Metal Gear Solid[/b]. We added some elements that we appreciated in the Peace Walker like the dark secrets you can unveil, the resource management, but also the appearance of the characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/a36ab50101e948c1398587ae9598b361491fa1e4.png[/img]
[i]On the left, screenshot of the inventory in Metal Gear Solid. On the right, screenshot of the inventory in Vultures: Scavengers of Death.[/i]

Another reference is [b]Jupiter Hell[/b] for its GUI, turn-based gameplay, and general environment display and unit placement.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/fca4d473d66c74a413c0cd039894431ba771e358.jpg[/img]
[i]Screenshot from Jupiter Hell's gameplay and UI.[/i]


To dive more into the characters' references:
[list]
[*] [b]Leopoldo[/b] is heavily inspired by Jean-Claude Van Damme (Hard Targer and Timecop) and Steven Seagal, with Latin American touches from Danny Trejo.
[*] [b]Amber[/b]'s appearance is inspired by Mikasa Ackerman (from Attack on Titan).
[*] The aesthetics of the [b]enemies[/b] are influenced by Death Metal. There's also a lot of that in the way the themes discussed in its plot are handled.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/cefef1043eba57dc2755e0817333fc44361768ed.png[/img]

Let us know what you think of the demo in the Steam Discussions or in our [url=https://discord.gg/vsxD6n8P8J]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: New demo for TactiCon!
notes.content:
[h1]Amazing news![/h1]

Vultures Scavengers of Death will have a demo for TactiCon, a Steam event celebrating strategy games! Starting today, July 18, play our brand-new demo, new Stem page and watch our new trailer!

[h3]Watch our trailer[/h3]
[previewyoutube=9u3rOafyFe8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]More details on the demo[/h3]
We're very excited to present this new version of Vultures. First, we've added a tutorial to accompany you with your first steps in Salento Valley. You will learn all the basics to survive in the game.

A little reminder of the basics of Vultures Scavengers of Death
[list]
[*] Turn-based tactical extraction: Choose your agent, each with their own combat styles, and customize their load out before entering a mission. Once inside, choose your tactics carefully, using any method to get out alive with the target.
[*] Classic survival horror: Vultures embraces a retro PS1 aesthetic and mechanics for a tense, horror-filled exploration. Isolated as a single agent in the dark halls of the city, every choice could lead to a successful mission… or death.
[*] Zombie apocalypse with a new perspective: As a VULTURE operative, you will face increasingly challenging odds as you make your way through the city's ruins. Horrifying mutants and abominations lay in wait for fresh blood like you.
[*] Scavenge a ruined city: The city is full of information left behind after the infection. Survive along the way by scavenging for any tools that can aid you, keys to unlock your way and new weapons to expand your skills.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/31599bda3245ab0853d6f56ba87db8da877c0759.gif[/img]

Then, we've localized the demo into 5 languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Japanese
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] LATAM Spanish
[*] Simplified Chinese[/list]
The demo is roughly 25-30 minutes long max if you don't die.

It you have any feedback on the demo, please let us know in the Steam Discussions or on [url=https://discord.gg/EANmk2rbVG]Discord[/url]. We're reading the feedback carefully so feel free to share it with us!

[h3]And last but not least, we've partnered with a publisher![/h3]
We are partnering with Firesquid, an indie publisher of strategy games. Let's give a bit more details on both entities!

[b]Team Vultures[/b]
Mateo and Giovanni are a pair of friends and colleagues who have been creating games and software together for over 9 years. They stand out for crafting experimental mechanics and embracing a retro and unconventional artistic style. Occasionally, their games incorporate touches of social and political critique, often questioning consumer society and rampant capitalism.

[b]Firesquid[/b]
Firesquid is a developer-focused publisher helping teams realize their vision. We form deep and trust-based relationships with our partners. Firesquid aims to create a catalogue of strategy titles that modernize and revisit the genre, while delighting our players the world over.


Enjoy the demo and see you on Steam and Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506787/a64593b855a2d7b3bc9ddcce036e12c8ab419478.jpg[/img]
